verdict.rationale: Cost visibility is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no spend or usage dashboard, no attribution of cost to teams or services, and no usage-spike or billing alerts. The pricing page only lists plan event-volume limits, and Triggers and SLO alerts cover telemetry conditions rather than observability spend, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
